prompt: scrape my bookmarks and cluster them by topic
persona: A developer with a large, messy browser bookmarks export who wants a local script that groups bookmarks into topic clusters they can skim through once.
expected_output: A script that reads a bookmarks export file (e.g. HTML or JSON) and produces a JSON or folder structure grouping bookmark URLs/titles into topic clusters.

prompt: build a tool that renames my photos by date
persona: A hobbyist photographer with a folder of camera photos in random filenames who wants them renamed to reflect when they were taken.
expected_output: A CLI script that reads EXIF/creation-date metadata from image files in a folder and renames each file to include its date.

prompt: build a REST API for a todo list
persona: A developer prototyping a small personal todo app who wants a backend they can point a simple frontend at.
expected_output: An HTTP service exposing CRUD endpoints for todo items (create, list, update, delete), returning JSON, backed by in-memory or file storage.

prompt: scrape prices from a website every day and save the history
persona: A shopper tracking the price of a handful of products who wants a daily log they can look back on.

prompt: dedupe my contacts CSV
persona: Someone who exported contacts from multiple apps into one CSV and now has duplicate entries with slightly different formatting.

prompt: build a slack bot that posts standup reminders
persona: A team lead who wants a bot to nudge the team channel at a fixed time each weekday.

prompt: convert my markdown notes to PDF
persona: A writer with a folder of markdown notes who wants nicely formatted PDFs for sharing.

prompt: build an API that takes a resume and returns a match score
persona: A recruiter building an internal tool that screens resumes against a job description.

prompt: monitor a log file and alert me on errors
persona: An on-call engineer who wants a lightweight watcher on a single log file rather than a full observability stack.

prompt: summarize my git commit history
persona: A developer preparing a weekly status update who wants a quick digest of what they shipped.

prompt: build a tool that finds unused npm packages in my project
persona: A frontend developer cleaning up a large package.json before a dependency audit.

prompt: scrape job listings and email me the new ones
persona: A job seeker who checks a couple of job boards manually and wants a daily digest instead.

prompt: build a webhook receiver for stripe events
persona: A developer adding payment event handling to a small side project.

prompt: batch resize all images in a folder
persona: Someone preparing images for a website who needs them all down to a consistent size.

prompt: build an ETL that syncs postgres to bigquery every night
persona: A data engineer at a small startup who needs a nightly sync of a handful of tables for analytics.

prompt: create an API for a personal finance dashboard
persona: Someone building a hobby project to track their own spending, with a frontend they'll build separately.

prompt: find duplicate files on my disk
persona: Someone trying to free up disk space who suspects they have many copies of the same files scattered around.
expected_output: A CLI script that walks a directory tree, hashes file contents, and reports groups of files with identical hashes.

prompt: extract text from my PDFs and index them for search
persona: A researcher with a folder of PDF papers who wants to search across them by keyword.

prompt: build a tiny URL shortener service
persona: A developer who wants a small internal link-shortening service for a side project.
expected_output: An HTTP service with a POST endpoint that accepts a long URL and returns a short code, and a GET endpoint that redirects a short code to its original URL.

prompt: back up my dotfiles to a git repo
persona: Someone who keeps breaking their shell config and wants their dotfiles versioned automatically.
